Jwt._comment: Dev-only base64 HS256 key (32 bytes). Production MUST override via env var Jwt__SigningKey (no prefix -- GOMOKU_ is silently ignored, measured). Program.cs refuses to start in Production if empty.

Cors._comment: Overlays appsettings.json. ALL origins must be listed: .NET merges config arrays by INDEX, so a shorter array here overwrites the first N entries of the base one and silently drops the rest.
